items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So Merle and Roy and Pete and myself, we said, well, we'll meet at the railroad station about train time to go to Kansas City.

ctx.x: What were the other guys doing?
Oh, well, Roy didn't -- Merle finally went on back to Des Moines. And Pete, he disappeared from the scene.
So you were there by yourself?
